game_title: Capstone Boss Chain – Palm Grove Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Palm Grove, a palm grove: the camel trader must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Capstone Boss Chain: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks.
theme: Sand Dunes – Palm Grove: a palm grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Palm Grove, repeat each round: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks. Each round, dust devils strike the oasis, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the boss_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the oasis from dust devils in Palm Grove: keep the boss_hp meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: boss_hp drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Capstone Boss Chain
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Capstone Boss Chain' (Week 9 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Palm Grove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how boss_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Palm Grove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 38 seconds while boss_hp > 0.
